principle: Architecturally comprehensive does not mean production-complete.

definitions.LIVE: Production deployed and required user-path tests passed.
definitions.READY: Built and internally validated, but not yet released to production.
definitions.BUILDING: Implementation or required validation is incomplete.
definitions.LOCKED: Code or design may exist, but a required security, legal, rights, operations, payment, or dependency gate prevents activation.
definitions.COMING SOON: Planned architecture that is not yet sufficiently implemented to call READY.
